title: AI Shoe UGC Ads From a Product Photo | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one shoe photo into on-foot demos, unboxings, fit checks, and listing photos. Download clips and photos with no watermark for posts and product pages.
h1: AI Product Photos for Shoe Brands, On Foot and in Motion
lead: Shoppers want the pair on a foot, not only on a plain white background. Paste a product link or one clear side photo. You get a listing photo and a short step. Credits are what each job spends.
card: On-foot steps, unboxings, fit checks, and listing photos from one shoe photo.

faq.q: Can one shoe photo make both a listing image and a walking clip?
faq.a: Yes. A clear side view can guide a white-background photo and a short on-foot scene. Keep the toe, heel, ankle opening, and sole edge visible so the pair stays recognizable.

faq.q: Can I get a sole or heel view from a side shot?
faq.a: Start from a separate photo of the sole or the heel. A side photo cannot show a sole pattern that was not in your photo.

faq.q: Does this work for an Amazon main image?
faq.a: For a main image, use the shoe alone on pure white, filling most of the picture, with no extra objects and no text. Put size and width notes in the gallery or the listing text.

faq.q: Can I show a sneaker logo I do not own?
faq.a: If you ask for a logo or a brand mark you do not own, the request may be turned down. If you resell branded pairs, use your own straight product photos for those listings.
Start with one full side view, then a top view and a sole or heel shot. Those three show the shape and the sole pattern. Do not ask the picture to add a hidden part.

faq.q: How do I avoid a branded look on an unbranded pair?
faq.a: Start from a plain pair and check the result for stripes, sole shapes, or stitching that look like a known logo. Keep logos out of the source photo and the finished scene.

faq.q: Can I run the clips as paid footwear ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark, so no logo is stamped on the file. You can use them in paid ads. Keep comfort and performance claims to facts you can prove.

faq.q: How long is a shoe clip, and what does it cost?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Shapes are a tall phone (9:16), a square (1:1), a wide shape (16:9), 4:3, or a tall 3:4. Those lengths spend 24, 40, 60, and 120 credits. If the clip fails, those credits come back. The person on screen is created by the tool, not a real reviewer.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link and make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page, or send that link from your own shop software (the API). Ask for a short script and pick a person the tool creates. Make a few versions, including one in another language. Trim the clip in the editor on this page. Choose a voice and a music track, and check the captions. Then send it to TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram. The clip only shows angles that were in your photo.
